verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a deprecation policy is a fair question for a cloud data warehouse. The evidence pack never documents API versioning or a deprecation policy. The closest items are a recommendation to prefer the gRPC Storage Write API over REST and a Rust SDK being in Preview; neither is a versioning or deprecation commitment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
